title: Transfer Candidates
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of cross-domain-transfer-scout. Lists candidate methods or ideas from one domain that could be transferred to the target research domain. Each candidate carries source_domain + target_hook, so it is a direct classify_gap signal that maps to (transfer_gap, XFER_BIND) — rule 1 in the priority table (highest precedence). An empty candidates array is allowed (the surveyed work may have no identifiable transfer opportunities). Every present item carries at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop).

candidates.description: Cross-domain transfer candidates; each carries source_domain + target_hook so classify_gap can consume it directly.

source_domain.description: The domain the method or idea originates from. Non-blank required.

target_hook.description: The specific problem or technique in the target domain where the transfer would apply. Non-blank required.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers grounding this transfer candidate (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

method_ref.description: Optional reference to the specific method or paper in the source domain.
